images.filename: Old Cottage on South Hill, Samson - geograph.org.uk - 455577.jpg
images.caption: Old Cottage on South Hill, Samson One of several old cottages clustered around a spring on South Hill Samson. In the near foreground is Bar Point, the landing point where you do indeed need to remove footwear and roll up trouser legs to get ashore (and back) as in the First Geograph picture for this square. Puffin Island is just right of centre in mid distance. Bryher (left) and Tresco (right) form the distant background.

In the near foreground is Bar Point, the landing point where you do indeed need to remove footwear and roll up trouser legs to get ashore (and back) as in the First Geograph picture for this square. images.filename: Deer Park Wall and Cottage, South Hill, Samson - geograph.org.uk - 929094.jpg
images.caption: Deer Park Wall and Cottage, South Hill, Samson Samson was depopulated in 1855. Augustus Smith had a wall erected around 3.5 hectares of the northern slopes of South Hill to create a deer park. By 1860 the forest loving animals had escaped to the nearby wooded island of Tresco.

images.caption: Lichen covered wall, South Hill, Samson Lichen is a good indicator of pure pollutant-free air. The cottage was probably occupied until 1855 and was one of the better quality homes on the island.

images.filename: Beach on Samson, Isles of Scilly - geograph.org.uk - 1615422.jpg
images.caption: Beach on Samson, Isles of Scilly The landing on Samson is at the right of the beach as visible here. The land behind this beach is low-lying and occupied by dune vegetation. The water in the foreground is very shallow and is sand and rock at low tide.
images.alt: Beach on Samson, Isles of Scilly The landing on Samson is at the right of the beach as visible here. The land behind this beach is low-lying and occupied by dune vegetation. The water in the foreground is very shallow and is sand and rock at low tide.

images.caption: Samson from Porthloo, Scilly The twin hills of Samson are visible from much of Scilly. Here they are enjoying the calm sea and summer sunshine.
